Getting started

Get into your workspace, find your way around, and take your first steps with JOHN CRM.

On this page
Sign in to JOHN CRMCreate or join a workspaceSwitch between workspacesFind your way aroundTake your first steps

Sign in to JOHN CRM

  1. 1Open your team’s JOHN CRM sign-in page. Use your email and password, or Continue with Google.
  2. 2If you received an invitation, open its link and use the invited email address to create an account or sign in.
  3. 3Forgot your password? Use the password reset option on the sign-in page and follow the email link.

Create or join a workspace

Your workspace brings together your team’s customers, conversations, knowledge and settings. Check its name before making changes.

  1. 1On the welcome screen, choose Add Workspace. Create My Own starts a workspace for your team; follow the name, connection and invitation steps shown.
  2. 2To join an existing team, choose Join a Workspace and paste the invitation link or token. You can also accept a pending invitation from the invitations inbox.
  3. 3Complete any plan setup shown before using the CRM. An invitation alone does not add you to a workspace: accept it to join.

Switch between workspaces

Open the workspace switcher at the bottom of the sidebar, or in Settings → Profile, and select a workspace you belong to. The app reloads with that workspace’s data and your permissions there. Finish any unsaved edits before switching.

Working with more than one team

Each workspace keeps its own records. Joining another team does not copy customers, conversations or knowledge into it. Some branded workspaces keep the switcher hidden.

Find your way around

  • Users holds customer records. Workspace → Members manages the people who sign in and work with you.
  • Internal Chat holds customer conversations. External Chat holds website visitor conversations. Calendar shows appointments, scheduled messages and automation runs.
  • Knowledge Base supplies information for AI replies. Automations runs recurring or triggered work. John Support helps you use and configure the app.
  • Settings contains personal preferences. Configurations contains workspace behaviour and connections.

Take your first steps

  1. 1Open Users and add your first customer, or open an existing record to check its contact details.
  2. 2Ask an administrator to check your messaging connection in Configurations. Add a short, current FAQ to Knowledge Base if you manage your team’s content.
  3. 3Open John Support and ask a specific question, such as “How do I take over a conversation from the AI?”
A workspace or feature is missing

Check the signed-in email and current workspace first. An expired invitation needs a fresh link from the inviter. Feature availability also depends on your workspace and permissions; ask an owner or administrator, or contact John Support.
